SRI LANKA PORTS AUTHORITY ACT, No. 51 OF 1979
Notification
ORDER made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping and Southern Development under Sub Section (3) of Section 2 of theSri Lanka Ports Authority Act, No. 51 of 1979.
SAGALA RATNAYAKA,Minister of Ports & Shipping and Southern Development.Colombo,17th July, 2019.
ORDER

Whereas Order pertaining to Port Limits of the Port of Hambantota was specified in the Order dated 25.09.2017and has been published in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2038/15 dated 25.09.2017, the additional sea area is placedunder the jurisdiction of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority as specified in the Schedule attached hereto.
